item.title: Trump’s Medicaid work mandate could kick thousands of homeless Californians off coverage
item.description: A majority of California’s roughly 180,000 people experiencing homelessness have health insurance through Medi-Cal. Providers predict that many will lose insurance under President Donald Trump’s upcoming work mandates even if they qualify for exemptions.
